Simple CRM Software for
Small Business Teams.

Manage leads, track deals, automate follow-ups, and close more revenue — without the complexity of enterprise CRM tools you've already outgrown.

The problem

Messy pipelines.
Zero visibility.

Small business sales teams lose deals not because of bad salespeople — but because tools are disconnected, data is stale, and follow-ups fall through the cracks.

AI on every step.

QuikCRM is simple CRM software for small business teams — replacing the spreadsheet chaos with one intelligent workspace where your pipeline, contacts, and automations live together.

Features

Everything your sales team needs
to close more deals.

Built for small business sales teams that need a CRM they will actually use — not another tool collecting dust.

Pipeline Management
Visualise your entire sales funnel in Kanban, list, or forecast view. Drag deals between stages, set requirements, and track velocity.
  • Unlimited custom pipeline stages
  • Deal health scoring
  • Stage-based automation triggers
  • Multi-pipeline support
star
AI Sales Automation
Let AI handle the follow-up work. Automatic email drafts, meeting summaries, lead scoring, and next-action suggestions — all hands-free.
  • AI-written follow-up emails
  • Close probability scoring
  • Auto-assign leads to reps
  • Smart meeting transcripts
trending_up
Reporting and Analytics
Revenue dashboards, rep performance, conversion rates, and pipeline forecasts — updated in real time, no spreadsheet required.
  • Real-time revenue dashboards
  • Rep leaderboards
  • Win/loss analysis
  • Custom report builder
person
Contact and Account Management
A 360° view of every contact and company. Track emails, calls, meetings, and deals in one unified timeline.
  • Unified contact timeline
  • Company hierarchy mapping
  • Email and calendar sync
  • Custom fields and tags
bolt
Workflow Automation
Build automations visually. Trigger actions when deals move, contacts are created, or deadlines pass — zero code required.
  • Visual workflow builder
  • Time-based triggers
  • Multi-step sequences
  • Slack and email notifications
smartphone
Mobile and Field Sales
Full CRM power in your pocket. Log calls, update deals, and view AI insights — even when you're on the road with a client.
  • iOS and Android apps
  • Offline mode
  • Voice-to-note logging
  • GPS check-in for visits

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about QuikCRM — from setup and imports to AI features and pipeline management.

What is simple CRM software for small business?−
It's a platform built for small and growing sales teams — with contact management, pipeline tracking, deal automation, and AI follow-ups in one place. Unlike enterprise CRM tools, it is designed to be set up in minutes and used by teams from day one.
How is QuikCRM different from Salesforce or HubSpot?+
QuikCRM is built for small business teams that need pipeline visibility and follow-up automation without complex setup, expensive add-ons, or a dedicated admin. Most teams are running their full pipeline in QuikCRM on day one.
Can I import my existing contacts and deals?+
Yes. QuikCRM supports one-click import from Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and CSV. Your contacts, deals, and activity history come across cleanly — no manual re-entry needed.
How does AI follow-up automation work?+
When a deal reaches a specific stage or a contact goes quiet, QuikCRM AI drafts a follow-up email, sets a reminder, and flags the deal for your attention. You review and send — the AI does the writing.
Can I track deals across multiple pipelines?+
Yes. QuikCRM supports multiple pipelines with custom stages — so you can manage new business, renewals, and upsells in separate views without mixing your data.
How does close probability scoring work?+
QuikCRM AI analyses deal age, activity history, engagement signals, and stage velocity to assign a close probability to every deal. This gives your forecast real numbers instead of gut feels and guesses.
Does QuikCRM work with Gmail and Outlook?+
Yes. QuikCRM syncs with both Gmail and Outlook — logging emails, calendar events, and meeting notes directly to the relevant contact or deal record, automatically.
Is QuikCRM part of the Quikit platform?+
Yes. QuikCRM is one of 11 connected apps in the Quikit platform. Deal data links directly to QuikTrack for project delivery, QuikScale for revenue goal tracking, and QuikSocial for client communication — so sales and delivery stay connected.
